2608.04003.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
2608.04003.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain preferences, task histories, tool routines, and learned skills across sessions. Yet whether retained experience actually improves them over time has not been systematically tested. We introduce PAST-Bench, a benchmark designed to isolate this question. Each agent runs through ordered sequences of fresh-session tasks under matched conditions that turn retained experience on and off. It spans 26 scenarios and 204 episodes across memory, procedural reuse, information gathering, and update. We report both later-task gains and whether those gains follow the intended save, retrieve, and update pathway. Across seven base models and four agent frameworks, improvement is real but uneven across capabilities. Agents with the same headline gain can differ markedly in whether that gain is supported by evidence of the intended pathway. Guided by these findings, we develop Hermes+, which extends Hermes with five targeted interventions across stages of the agent loop. Hermes+ raises the average gain from retained experience and provides clearer pathway evidence, with its strongest improvement on tasks requiring outdated state to be replaced, although the effect remains capability- and model-dependent. Together, PAST-Bench and Hermes+ provide an evaluation and diagnostic foundation for studying how persistent agents can progress from retaining experience to systematically improving through it. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
2608.04003.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改進要求代理將累積的經驗轉化為更好的未來行為。個人 AI 代理提供了一個具體的環境來研究這一能力，因為它們在會話中保留了偏好、任務歷史、工具例程和學習技能。然而，保留的經驗是否實際上隨著時間的推移而改善它們，尚未進行系統性的測試。我們介紹了 PAST-Bench，這是一個旨在孤立這一問題的基準。每個代理在匹配的條件下，通過新會話任務的有序序列運行，這些條件會開啟和關閉保留的經驗。它涵蓋了 26 種場景和 204 個情節，涉及記憶、程序重用、信息收集和更新。我們報告了後續任務的增益以及這些增益是否遵循預期的保存、檢索和更新路徑。在七個基本模型和四個代理框架中，改進是真實的，但在能力上不均勻。擁有相同表面增益的代理在該增益是否得到預期路徑的證據支持方面可能有顯著差異。在這些發現的指導下，我們開發了 Hermes+，它在代理循環的各個階段擴展了 Hermes，並進行了五項針對性的干預。Hermes+ 提高了從保留經驗中獲得的平均增益，並提供了更清晰的路徑證據，其在需要用過時狀態進行替換的任務上有最強的改進，儘管這一效果仍然依賴於能力和模型。總體而言，PAST-Bench 和 Hermes+ 提供了一個評估和診斷的基礎，以研究持久代理如何從保留經驗進步到系統性地通過這些經驗進行改進。代碼：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/PAST-Bench
